RateLimiting._comment: Development ONLY. tests/api signs in once per test — `tokens` in conftest.py is function-scoped so the refresh-rotation and reuse-detection tests each get their own token family — which is a few hundred logins from 127.0.0.1 in under a minute. Against the production ceiling of 10 per 5 minutes the suite 429s from the eleventh test onward. The limiter itself stays ON here rather than being disabled, so the 429 path is still exercised; only the ceiling moves. Production inherits the defaults in RateLimitPolicies.
